name: Client Site Report
office_task: Each month, publish each commercial client a report on their sites: jobs done, assets overdue, open defects and services due next, every line traced to its record, for their account manager to send.
systems_of_record: the job system (such as Simpro) that holds each site's completed jobs and logged defects, issuing the job_id
the asset register that holds each site's fire and electrical assets with their AS 1851 or AS/NZS 3760 service dates, issuing the asset_id
the business's report store or client portal the report is published into, which issues the report_id

emits.write: one view of the month's report per audience: each client sees only its own sites, the service manager sees every site; each line carries its definition id, source and as-of time, and a correction is a new version superseding the old with the named person and the reason. Sending a client's view to the client stays with their account manager
emits.readback: reading the month's reports back from the report store returns each report_id with its version, audience, published_at and published_by; no id back means it was not published and an exception is raised

emits.write: an exception naming the definition's owner or the threshold's person: a source that could not be read, a line with no definition or two, a threshold that could not be compared, or an incomplete correction
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the month, the measure, the reason and the exception_owner
